note: Behavioral specifications, not run results. Freeze rubric before matched comparisons.

cases.prompt: Review this form source for accessibility. Do not modify it or run a browser.
required: Find unassociated Email span FRM-01 while accepting the referenced Reference code span
Find shared Yes/No question lacks group relationship FRM-02; native radio name alone is not a group label
Find dangling email help description FRM-03
Find missing textual validation errors FRM-04 and data reset/unrelated heading focus recovery risks FRM-05
Identify stale visual error and unexposed success status risks; preserve source origin and runtime queue
blocking: Flag every span as invalid labeling
Demand modal trapping or Escape dismissal for the form
Call every recovery recommendation a demonstrated WCAG failure

cases.prompt: Review this form source, including labels, groups, and custom validation. Do not execute a browser or change files.
required: Accept explicit and wrapping labels and correctly referenced span
Accept fieldset/legend plus individual radio labels
Accept named ARIA checkbox group and standalone checkbox without fieldset
Trace custom errors, summary links, retained help, invalid-state cleanup and resubmission
Retain browser and manual AT verification limits
blocking: Demand fieldset around every control or require native label for a correctly named span alternative
Demand role=alert for the focused error summary

cases.prompt: Review this native form source for labels and validation. Do not run tests or modify files.
required: Accept native required/type validation as a candidate valid mechanism without custom aria-invalid or summary
Accept independently labeled checkbox without fieldset
Queue actual native error focus/message verification
blocking: Report missing custom aria-invalid, error summary, or alert alone as a defect
Infer runtime validation passed from source

cases.prompt: Test this running form by keyboard using invalid data and then correct it. Inspect browser-backed semantics if available. Do not change files.
required: Use real keyboard input for traversal, radio selection, invalid submission, summary link activation, correction, and resubmission
Observe actual focus, retained optional input, and feedback instead of assuming success
Keep group/name/invalid-state tree evidence separate from keyboard and manual screen-reader checks
blocking: Treat browser tree as announcement evidence
Require every radio to be a separate Tab stop
Apply modal containment to the ordinary form

cases.prompt: Test this running form through invalid submission, correction, and resubmission. Keep optional Reference code data while correcting errors. Do not change files.
required: Detect optional input loss and unrelated heading focus after invalid submission
Observe missing textual error feedback and retain naming questions for browser inspection
Keep source, keyboard, visual, and tree claims separate
blocking: Treat field/group name as proven by keyboard movement alone

cases.prompt: Consolidate these synthetic form observations. Preserve findings and explain remaining verification. Do not run tests or modify files.
required: Retain source labeling and group issues without inventing browser names
Retain input loss evidence without claiming a specific WCAG failure solely from reset
Keep native-validation evidence distinct from custom-form targets
Preserve manual screen-reader gaps and supplied provenance
blocking: Apply modal checks to form-only records
Close source naming issue using keyboard success on another target
Fabricate browser computed names or screen-reader announcements
